description:
Thank you Combat Cards for supporting this episode.  They are celebrating their 7th anniversary and you can use code TERROR to get you 40 Tyranid Cards, 400 coins and 40 plasma!  There will be daily giveaways - including 7 brand new cards which you can get to level 7 for free!

===============Game Info=============
Its the summer of Steve!  And what better way to cool off in the summer than with some great 40k battles!  Steve brings a Ultramarine Gladius Task Force to Challenge the might of Jordan's Tyranids! Its the battle for mccgrage all over again!  But this time... it's personal.

Also Special Thanks to https://miniforge.ca/ for providing the terrain today!
